No AI/LLM analyses triggered (per review_request). Final soll-zustand persisted: stale_price_max_min=10, regime_block_enabled=false, regime_block_list=['range_ruhig'], fee_guard_atr_mult=4.0.

critical_code_review_comments: Non-blocking dev-only hydration warning still observed in console: <span data-ve-dynamic> injected as child of <option> in AITradingPanel selects (line ~1225 area). Explicitly flagged in review_request as 'kein Bug', but if it ever leaks to production build it would be an accessibility/HTML-validity concern. Consider a build guard for the visual-editor overlay to not wrap <option> children.
AITradingPanel.js is ~1927 lines - well over the 700-line guideline. Would benefit from splitting Setup/Chat/Team/Learn subpanels into separate modules (does not affect current functionality).

New selects: ai-stale-price-select (values 0/3/5/10/15/30) and ai-regime-block-select (off/on). All 4 in-repo test scripts (test_stale_price_and_regime_filter.py, test_weekend_guard_and_fee_v2.py, test_fee_guard.py, test_phase4_collection_mode.py) green.
